text.cs: Amlishagen Castle is a castle near the village of Amlishagen, which is a section of the town of Gerabronn, in the Schwäbisch Hall District of Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
text.da: Amlishagen Castle is a castle near the village of Amlishagen, which is a section of the town of Gerabronn, in the Schwäbisch Hall District of Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
text.de: Die Burg Amlishagen ist eine Spornburg über dem Brettachtal beim Dorf Amlishagen, einem Stadtteil von Gerabronn im Landkreis Schwäbisch Hall in Baden-Württemberg.
